title: Temp target from carbs menu always triggers Hypo target
body:
Build `3bb0705a03-2024.04.02`, the bug has been present for quite some time now.

When entering carbs, there's an option to also activate a TempTarget at the same time, giving option for all three presets: Activity, Eating soon, Hypo. If any of them is selected, regardless which, the result is Hypo temp target being activated.
